name: flex-status
description: Responsive status band above the prompt: folds onto more rows instead of cutting info when the terminal narrows; every segment can be moved, hidden or restyled

left.title: Left segments
left.description: Ids in order, "," joins within a group, "|" starts a new group. Ids: model, effort, account, folder, git, ttl, 5h, 7d, cache, session, clock.

right.title: Right segments
right.description: Same syntax as left. Leave an id out to hide it.

bar.title: Context bar
bar.description: Draw the bar that runs up to the auto-compact point.

sepInner.title: Separator inside a group
sepInner.description: One symbol; a space is added on each side.

sepLeft.title: Separator between left groups
sepLeft.description: One symbol; a space is added on each side.

sepRight.title: Separator between right groups
sepRight.description: One symbol; a space is added on each side.

segments.title: Per-segment options (JSON)
segments.description: {"git":{"icon":"","counts":false},"folder":{"depth":2},"clock":{"hour12":true,"seconds":true},"cache":{"decimals":0},"5h":{"reset":false},"model":{"color":"#ff8800"}}. Any segment: icon ("" drops it), color. folder: depth. git: counts. 5h/7d: reset. cache: decimals. clock: hour12, seconds.
